channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Toffoli libera Grassi a fazer campanha digital e participar de debates
item.description: Minister Dias Toffoli reversed a prior decision and authorized Wilson Grassi, candidate from the Democrata party, to conduct digital campaigning, participate in debates, and access electoral fund resources. The decision enables the candidate to expand visibility and voter engagement ahead of the 2026 presidential elections.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro: Esse tal do Lula foi único a não se pronunciar sobre escândalo de Moraes
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro criticized Supreme Court minister Alexandre de Moraes again, claiming Lula owes his third term to the judge. During a live stream, the PL candidate questioned the STF's neutrality and highlighted Moraes' influence in Brazilian politics. The remarks were made amid the campaign for the 2026 elections.

item.title: Alcolumbre sai em defesa de Moraes e cita envolvimento de Flávio Bolsonaro com Vorcaro
item.description: Davi Alcolumbre defended Alexandre de Moraes against opposition pressure, highlighting Flávio Bolsonaro's involvement with businessman Vorcaro. The Senate president rejected the opening of an impeachment process against the STF minister. The defense occurs amid political criticism regarding Moraes' performance.

item.title: Lula recebe Leonardo DiCaprio para conversa sobre mudanças climáticas
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva met with actor and activist Leonardo DiCaprio at the Presidential Palace to discuss climate change impacts and Brazilian government environmental initiatives. The meeting emphasized Brazil's commitment to environmental preservation and collaborative actions against deforestation.

item.title: TSE valida seis registros de candidatura à Presidência; ainda faltam sete
item.description: The TSE validated six presidential candidates for the 2026 election, with review led by ministers André Mendonça and Estela Aranha. Seven candidate registrations are still pending approval. The 2026 electoral calendar continues, generating expectations about new entrants in the race.

item.title: Nova pesquisa Quaest mostra eleição presidencial no maior colégio eleitoral do Brasil
item.description: A new Quaest poll, scheduled for release on September 8th, will examine the 2026 presidential election, testing a potential runoff between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro. The survey will also assess gubernatorial and Senate races in São Paulo, measuring voting intentions and electoral decision-making clarity.

item.title: Alcolumbre rebate cobrança por impeachment de Moraes e cita caso Dark Horse
item.description: The President of the Senate, Davi Alcolumbre, criticized the R$130 million payment requested by Daniel Vorcaro for the Dark Horse film, using the case to reinforce his stance against the impeachment requests for Alexandre de Moraes. He highlighted the hypocrisy of requesting money to produce content about Jair Bolsonaro and now attempting to incriminate Moraes for alleged irregularities. Tensions at the Supreme Federal Court have escalated after a PF report revealed dialogues between Moraes and Vorcaro.

item.title: Lula intensifica campanha com 7 atos em 10 dias e foco no Sul
item.description: Lula intensifies campaign with seven events in 10 days, focusing on visits to Ceará, São Paulo, Piauí, and a tour of three rallies in the South (RS, PR, SC). The agenda includes events backing PT allies like Elmano de Freitas and Leandro Grass, while avoiding states such as Pernambuco and Maranhão, where the PT has its own candidates.

item.title: Veja como foi a quarta-feira (2) dos candidatos a presidente
item.description: On Wednesday (2), the presidential candidates carried out varied agendas, with highlights including Samara Martins, who met with students and workers in Rio de Janeiro, and Augusto Cury, who visited the Jewish community in São Paulo. Wilson Grassi protested against the suspension of his social media campaign by the TSE, reaffirming that his candidacy is entirely digitally funded. Other candidates, such as Lula, Flávio Bolsonaro, and Rui Costa Pimenta, did not have public agendas disclosed.

item.title: MG: Lagoa Santa recebe Campeonato Brasileiro de Canoagem com 534 atletas
item.description: Lagoa Santa, in the Metropolitan Region of Belo Horizonte, will host the 2026 Brazilian Kayak Sprint and Paracanoe Championships from September 3 to 6, featuring 534 athletes from 36 clubs across 11 states. The competition includes 260 races across youth to master categories, paracanoe events, and adaptive classes, contributing to the national ranking and future selections.

item.title: Pesquisas mostram Lula 5% pior que em 2022, aponta estrategista
item.description: Polling data from 2026 shows Lula is 5 percentage points below his 2022 performance, according to strategist Roberto Reis. Flávio Bolsonaro outperforms his father at the same stage of the race. The scenario reflects crystallized voter alignments and the incumbent effect.

item.title: Com Neymar, Santos e Palmeiras estão escalados para a Copa do Brasil
item.description: Santos and Palmeiras face each other tonight (September 2nd) at 9:30 PM at Vila Belmiro Stadium for the Copa do Brasil. With a 3-0 win from the first leg, Palmeiras can lose by up to two goals and still advance. Neymar and Gabigol are both listed in Santos' starting lineup, while Palmeiras has also announced their starting eleven.

item.title: Senado: oposição obstrui e fim da escala 6x1 não vai a plenário
item.description: The government base in the Senate decided not to send the PEC ending the 6x1 work scale to the plenary due to lack of guaranteed votes and opposition obstruction. Opposition leaders such as Rogério Marinho and Flávio Bolsonaro mobilized senators to prevent the vote, which is now expected after the first electoral round. The proposal provides for two paid rest days per week and reduces the workday from 44 to 40 hours.

item.title: Alcolumbre responde a pedido de impeachment de Moraes por relação com Vorcaro e alfineta Flávio
item.description: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre said previous requests of R$130 million to the same individual — a reference to Flávio Bolsonaro — were not questioned, while now only Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes is being targeted over alleged ties to businessman Daniel Vorcaro. Federal Police investigate million-dollar contracts between Vorcaro-linked companies and the law firm of Viviane Barci de Moraes, Moraes’ wife, as well as personal gifts provided to the justice.

item.title: Toffoli libera campanha digital do Wilson Grassi, candidato à Presidência da República
item.description: TSE Minister Dias Toffoli approved the digital campaign of Wilson Grassi, a Democrata presidential candidate, after a 3-day suspension. The ruling also enables FEFC funding and debate participation. Toffoli emphasized the legal obligation for candidates to report social media accounts to ensure transparency and fair competition.

item.title: “Alexandre é Lula e Lula é Alexandre”, diz Gaspar, vice de Flávio
item.description: Deputy Alfredo Gaspar (União Brasil-AL), running for vice-president under Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), claimed that Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes and President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva act jointly to supposedly undermine Bolsonarismo. Gaspar also suggested the Banco Master scheme reaches Lula and demanded punishment for lawmakers who made unfounded corruption accusations. He also criticized the performance of Attorney General Paulo Gonet and legislators who filed charges without evidence.

item.title: O alerta para Lula em pesquisa na reta final da campanha eleitoral, segundo diretor da Quaest
item.description: Quaest poll shows Lula government disapproval reached 48%, surpassing 45% approval, signaling a warning for reelection. Quaest's intelligence director Guilherme Russo warns that declining approval favors the opposition, especially among independent voters. The campaign faces challenges to regain support, with factors like the economy and news shaping voter sentiment.

item.title: O candidato à presidência que pode ser mais prejudicado pelo caso Moraes e Vorcaro, segundo diretor da Quaest
item.description: The case involving Supreme Court minister Alexandre de Moraes and former banker Daniel Vorcaro could have a negative electoral impact on President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, particularly due to his perceived political closeness to Moraes, according to an analyst from Quaest. It is expected that the episode will benefit the opposition, especially anti-system candidates.

item.title: Lula comemora aprovação de projeto que cria política para minerais críticos
item.description: President Lula celebrated the Senate approval of the bill creating the National Policy for Critical and Strategic Minerals, aiming to boost domestic processing. The proposal includes tax incentives of up to R$5 billion and the creation of a council linked to the Presidency to drive the production chain.

item.title: A tendência favorável em pesquisa para a campanha de Flávio na eleição presidencial
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign shows growth in voting intentions for a potential second round, according to Quaest. The latest survey indicates a technical tie between Lula (42%) and Flávio (41%), with Lula losing ground and Flávio gaining strength. The race is becoming more polarized and tighter.

item.title: Veja fotos de Leonardo DiCaprio em encontro com Lula e Janja em Brasília
item.description: Leonardo DiCaprio met with President Lula and First Lady Janja at the Palácio do Planalto in Brasília to discuss environmental preservation and bioeconomy. The conversation also covered the role of women in conserving natural reserves and protecting the Amazon rainforest, with Culture Minister Margareth Menezes in attendance.

item.title: Novas tecnologias facilitam atendimento a mulheres vítimas de violência
item.description: New technologies have facilitated assistance to women victims of violence in Brazil, such as virtual assistants and electronic systems for filing police reports. In São Paulo, the virtual assistant Júlia enabled nearly 36,000 interactions since 2020, with a 15% increase in protective measure requests between 2023 and 2025. The digitization of services has also enabled assistance outside business hours, expanding access to protection.

item.title: Alcolumbre sai em defesa de ministro e rebate Flávio: ‘Agora culpado de R$ 130 milhões para filme sou eu e Moraes’
item.description: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre defended Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes and criticized lawmakers pushing for his impeachment, linking the pressure to funding for a biographical film about Jair Bolsonaro. He recalled that Flávio Bolsonaro was offered R$ 130 million for the project, implying both are now 'responsible'.

item.title: Janja presenteia Leonardo DiCaprio com foto do Cacique Raoni
item.description: First Lady Janja Lula gifted Leonardo DiCaprio a photo of Chief Raoni during a meeting at Planalto Palace. Discussions focused on Amazon protection and indigenous communities.

item.title: STF sem opções: neste momento qualquer ação tende a agravar a crise institucional
item.description: The STF (Brazil's Supreme Court) faces an institutional crisis with no viable solution, worsened by Alexandre de Moraes's proximity to figures involved in criminal schemes. The court's dominant wing—composed of Moraes, Flávio Dino, and Gilmar Mendes—has lost legitimacy by being viewed as subservient to political and financial interests, threatening Lula's re-election and government stability.

item.title: Governo avalia sessão extra antes das eleições para votar 6 X 1
item.description: The federal government is considering holding an extraordinary session of the Senate in September 2026 to attempt approval of the constitutional amendment ending the 6 X 1 payroll scale, after opposition candidates successfully blocked attendance. Government leader Randolfe Rodrigues (PT-AP) says he has between 53 and 54 favorable votes but needs greater certainty regarding senator turnout. If gathering the senators proves impossible, the vote will be prioritized during the concentrated effort in October.

item.title: Escala 6x1: líder do governo reconhece não ter ‘garantia’ de votos e análise deve ficar para depois das eleições
item.description: The Brazilian Senate did not advance with the vote on the constitutional amendment ending the 6x1 workweek schedule, as the federal government lacked the 49 votes required for constitutional approval. The PT leader in Congress, Randolfe Rodrigues, stated that the support margin was insufficient and decided to postpone the vote until after the elections. The opposition allegedly coordinated to obstruct the plenary and prevent voting at this time.

item.title: Augusto Cury atribui alta em pesquisa a 'movimento de pacificação' do país
item.description: Augusto Cury (Avante) attributed his 10% rise in the Quaest poll to his speech on national pacification, placing third behind Lula (37%) and Flávio Bolsonaro (30%). He emphasized that the pacification movement is gaining voter support.

item.title: Senado aprova política nacional para minerais críticos e estratégicos
item.description: The Brazilian Senate approved the creation of the National Policy for Critical and Strategic Minerals, which provides for investments of up to R$ 7 billion to boost mineral processing and transformation in the country. The text, which moves to Lula's approval, was criticized for the lack of environmental safeguards.

item.title: Randolfe admite que 6x1 não será votada antes do 1º turno e culpa Flávio
item.description: Randolfe Rodrigues, the government leader in Congress, admitted that the PEC to end the 6x1 work schedule will not be voted on before the first round of the 2026 elections, attributing the delay to a 'coordinated action' by Flávio Bolsonaro. He emphasized the lack of guaranteed votes needed for approval, scheduling the vote for October, between the two electoral rounds.

item.title: A próxima pesquisa Nexus para presidente, após tensão entre Mendonça e Moraes
item.description: The upcoming Nexus/BTG poll for president will be released on September 8, following tensions between Supreme Court ministers André Mendonça and Alexandre de Moraes. The latest poll showed a tie between Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) in the second round, with Lula leading over other candidates in tested scenarios.

item.title: Janja recebe DiCaprio em meio ao silêncio de Lula sobre Moraes
item.description: Janja Lula hosted Leonardo DiCaprio at the Planalto amid Lula's campaign silence regarding the STF Moraes controversy.

item.title: Renan Santos protocola pedido de impeachment contra Moraes e Toffoli
item.description: Renan Santos filed impeachment requests against Supreme Court justices Alexandre de Moraes and Dias Toffoli at the Federal Senate. The accusations follow revelations about the relationship between former banker Daniel Vorcaro and Supreme Court members, including million-dollar contracts and personal favors offered to Moraes. Senate President Davi Alcolumbre will decide whether to archive or admit the requests.

item.title: TSE forma maioria para aprovar registros de candidatura de Lula, Flávio Bolsonaro e Romeu Zema
item.description: The TSE has formed a majority to approve the candidacy registrations of Lula, Flávio Bolsonaro, and Romeu Zema for the presidency, along with approving the Drap of their respective coalitions. The trial is taking place in the virtual plenary and awaits only the votes of ministers Estela Aranha and Ricardo Villas Bôas Cueva. Other presidential candidates, such as Samara Martins and Edmilson Costa, also have majority favorable votes.

item.title: Nunes Marques manda Eduardo Bolsonaro apagar publicações que questionam as urnas
item.description: TSE minister Nunes Marques ordered Eduardo Bolsonaro to remove posts questioning the reliability of electronic voting machines and banned further publications of the same nature. The ruling responded to a request from the Brazil Hope Federation, citing risks to electoral security. Posts by other PL lawmakers were deemed protected under freedom of expression.

item.title: Augusto Cury comemora 3° lugar na Quaest e cobra Moraes: “Deve se explicar”
item.description: Augusto Cury (Avante) demanded investigation of Alexandre de Moraes over alleged messages with Daniel Vorcaro and stated there will be no immunity in government. He celebrated 10% poll numbers in Quaest survey, ranking third behind Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Vorcaro diz a Mendonça que quer delatar pessoas do ‘atual governo’ e citaria relação com chefe da PF
item.description: Daniel Vorcaro told Minister André Mendonça he wants to implicate members of Lula’s government and hinted at a link with PF chief Andrei Rodrigues, without providing evidence. His plea deal proposal was rejected for withholding information and lacking new proof.

item.title: MP denuncia Magno Malta por agressão contra funcionária de hospital
item.description: The Public Ministry filed a criminal complaint against Senator Magno Malta for assaulting a nurse during hospitalization at a private hospital in Brasília. The victim claimed the senator attacked her during preparation for a contrast exam. Malta denied the accusations and the court set a 10-day deadline for response.

item.title: Senado aprova incentivos para exploração de minerais críticos no Brasil
item.description: The Senate approved a bill creating a national policy for critical and strategic minerals, with incentives for domestic processing. The proposal includes a guarantee fund of R$2 billion and tax credits of R$5 billion between 2030 and 2034, aiming to add value to mineral exports and generate jobs.

item.title: Discussão sobre impeachment de Moraes é inevitável, diz Gaspar
item.description: Alfredo Gaspar stated that the impeachment of Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes is inevitable, but ruled out its approval in the current Senate under Davi Alcolumbre's leadership. He also criticized the STF session to analyze Moraes' investigation, calling it a source of institutional fragility.

item.title: Terras raras: Senado aprova projeto com fundo garantidor e crédito de R$ 5 bi para estimular exploração
item.description: The Brazilian Senate approved a bill establishing the National Policy for Critical and Strategic Minerals (PNMCE), creating a guarantee fund and offering R$ 5 billion in tax credits to incentivize mineral processing in Brazil, including rare earths, with the bill now headed to President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva for promulgation.

item.title: Papo Antagonista: Pesquisas mostram Flávio subindo e Lula estável na corrida eleitoral
item.description: Pollster Polli Data shows Flávio Bolsonaro rising in the 2026 presidential race while Lula holds steady. The electoral landscape signals shifting dynamics.

item.title: Gonet interferiu em eleição para conselho do Ministério Público, aponta relatório da PF
item.description: A Federal Police report reveals that Attorney General Paulo Gonet interfered in the election for the leadership of CNPG to benefit Jarbas Soares Júnior, brother of lawyer Ciro Soares, close to banker Daniel Vorcaro. Messages indicate Gonet convinced Georges Seigneur to withdraw, while Vorcaro celebrated the political interference. The case also involves contacts between Gonet and Vorcaro before a London event with Brazilian authorities.

item.title: Deputados governistas veem parcialidade de Mendonça e pedem derrubada de sigilo do caso 'Dark Horse'
item.description: Lawmakers allied with Lula requested the lifting of the secrecy of the investigation into the funding of the film 'Dark Horse', which addresses Jair Bolsonaro. The action was filed with the STF to deepen the analysis of the partiality perceived on the part of Justice Dias Toffoli. The case involves former banker Daniel Vorcaro and investigations into possible irregularities in cultural funding with political bias.

item.title: Visita ao Poder360: Alfredo Gaspar
item.description: Alfredo Gaspar, running mate for Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), visited Poder360 headquarters in Brasília and gave his first interview since being named vice-presidential candidate. He claimed that Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes and President Lula are 'one and the same' and protect each other, also commenting on a potential Moraes impeachment and ongoing legal cases.

item.title: PL diz que Lula deve agir para não ser conivente no caso Vorcaro-Moraes
item.description: The PL urges Lula to take action regarding the Vorcaro-Moraes case to avoid being seen as complicit, following investigations involving billionaire contracts and interactions between the businessman and the STF minister. The party also demands the removal of the PF director and moves forward with a new impeachment request against Moraes.

item.title: 'Crise Master' no STF superou casos 'Dark Horse' e Lulinha em postagens nas redes sociais, aponta levantamento
item.description: The crisis involving STF Minister Alexandre de Moraes and banker Daniel Vorcaro generated over 1.1 million social media posts in 24 hours, surpassing previous cases like 'Dark Horse' and 'Lulinha'. The peak occurred nine hours after message revelations, with 84,000 posts at that hour. Most posts on X were from right-wing profiles demanding action against Moraes, while the left questioned the case handling by André Mendonça.

item.title: Sem citar Moraes, presidente do PT diz que ‘sistema apodreceu’ e pede mudança no Judiciário
item.description: Edinho Silva, PT party president, criticized the judiciary and called for ethics reforms without directly naming Minister Alexandre de Moraes, who is under a PF report linking him to banker Daniel Vorcaro. The report reveals payments of $50 million to the office of Moraes’ wife and luxury service offerings.

item.title: PEC da 6×1 esbarra na escala eleitoral do Senado
item.description: The PEC eliminating the 6×1 schedule was approved at the Senate CCJ, but faces resistance for full chamber voting due to the election calendar. Government supporters seek to expedite the process, but the Senate president prefers normal procedures, coinciding with the electoral campaign period.

item.title: Tucanos se aproximam de Cury e o veem como alternativa de centro
item.description: PSDB leaders and candidates are approaching Augusto Cury (Avante), seen as a center alternative for those rejecting Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro. Cury's discourse aligns with traditional tucan positions in recent years.
